acceptanceCriteria: Native pinned Rust CLI evidence covers executed-pass, assertion-fail, empty and all-skipped SQL record files, with raw argv/reports/exit retained.
Rust reports lacking trustworthy executed-record denominator remain UNKNOWN/incomplete or unsupported; JUnit file-level success cannot prove SQL assertion execution.
Only admit an adapter when native executed/skipped counts are reconciled; retain version-specific qualification and external dependency limits.
body:
Confirmed upstream report granularity limitation; no current Corvint false-pass claim: Rust reporter is not admitted as authoritative SQL runner. sqllogictest-bin0.29.1 executableSHA25abbbebf842dfdf33ae2edea38039f1fc21a6ebad8bdd4cd6dd0f724b2009b1, PostgreSQL17.11. Actual native argv and exit codes in runs.json: --engine postgres --host PRIVATE_SOCKET --port55437 --user corvint --pass empty --db postgres --color never --junit OUT CASE. Empty zero.slt and skipif-postgres query each exit0 and emit tests=1, failures=0, errors=0 with empty testcase and no skipped marker. Expected executed SQL record count distinguish executed pass, all-skipped and zero tests; actual file-level JUnit pass cannot establish execution. Current SQL README rejects Rust denominator; SQLite reference runner selected instead. Preserve limitation until native evidence can prove nonzero execution and skips, not by trusting synthetic count.
